resources.string: Analysis is read-only. Nothing is selected for cleanup automatically.
Analysis only: safe batch cleanup is unavailable for this database.
%1$d additional content items in the kept project
A verified encrypted recovery point is created first. Each selected project must still be fully covered by its kept project. Changed data stops this operation.
Restore the original projects only when their saved state still matches. Later changes and existing projects will not be overwritten; conflicts stop restoration.

One kept project must cover all content of a candidate, including account–password pairing, added content, repeated fields, attachments, history and native behavior. Partial overlap is kept. For A [1,2,3], B [1,2], C [2,3,4], only B is covered by A when identity and other properties match. Unknown or unreadable data is kept.
Some content cannot be read; keep this project.
Content cannot yet be fully verified; keep this project.
Linked content requires separate review; keep this project.
Project structure is inconsistent; keep this project.
Database locked. Unlock it and analyze again.
Analysis limit reached. Unverified projects are kept.
Analysis failed. Refresh and try again.
%1$d projects changed. Recovery points remain available.
The result needs verification. Check recovery points before retrying; do not repeat cleanup blindly.
Verified recovery is unavailable. Cleanup is disabled.
Database unavailable. Refresh after checking its connection and access.
Empty or unclassified content; keep this project.
Kept %1$d items with content that cannot yet be fully migrated or read.
Data changed. Analyze and review again.
Different content is kept separately, without choosing by age.
If the original KeePass item was removed from the recycle bin, restore a copy. Its original group must still exist.
Restored %1$d projects; %2$d records restored as copies.
Content cannot yet be fully verified. Keep this database unchanged and do not migrate it.
Add independent copies. Target content is not fully verified, so possible duplicates are not skipped.
Passkeys stay unchanged and are not deduplicated or copied.
This project contains or is linked to a Passkey. Keep the entire project out of deduplication.
Passkeys and projects containing or linked to Passkeys are kept in full. They will not be deleted, merged or copied.
Keep these and review other items

Analysis is read-only; cleanup or copying needs separate confirmation. Automatic results may be wrong or miss items. Review results and keep an independent backup before proceeding. Later changes may affect restoration; local recovery points do not replace backups.
Unknown or unreadable content, and projects whose fields or references cannot be fully verified, stay unchanged.
Cleanup is available only for Monica local and supported internal KDBX 4.1 databases. Bitwarden, MDBX and external KDBX are analysis-only. History and attachments must be fully compared.

Merging adds copies and keeps the sources. Failure may leave a partially completed operation. MDBX sources stay unchanged; MDBX targets receive independent copies. Projects with history, attachments or fields that cannot be fully migrated are kept.
